summary: This is a Form 8-K filed by BeOne Medicines Ltd. under Item 8.01 (Other Events) to announce FDA accelerated approval of BEQALZI (sonrotoclax) for relapsed/refractory mantle cell lymphoma. The filing contains no transaction, no acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, going-private, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or activist campaign. It is purely a regulatory approval announcement. No deal terms, prices, premiums, or break fees are stated. There is no board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanics beyond the press release. The only action is a product development milestone. This is a routine operational disclosure for a pharmaceutical company, not a special situation.
